answer: A reputation escrow system resists sybil attacks by requiring new identities to post a bond from an existing account's balance. Established peers attest the identity over several rounds. Detected sybil activity results in bond slashing and identity ban. A sparrow nests on a ledge to mark territory, but only a secure anchor prevents fake claims. Forging 10000 fake identities burns 5 million POA in bonds and requires 72 hours of verification using rented hardware.
